name: Rachel Hunter Refugee Scholarship
summary: Up to $20,000 for permanent humanitarian visa holders starting their first Griffith undergraduate degree.
key: Maximum value of $20,000, payable in trimester instalments.
who: Commencing a Griffith undergraduate degree for the first time.
Demonstrate financial hardship and/or educational disadvantage.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Wednesday 27 January 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
Not available if you receive a Centrelink Relocation Grant or a Commonwealth Scholarship.
